sourceText: User asked how B-3a4d will specifically close the durability gap after B-bfba: real DONE cleanup removed the story worktree while canonical main still lacked milestone-closeout.json, so post-DONE milestone_closeout could only report Snapshot: missing.
normalizedOutcome: After a real DONE merge/worktree cleanup, canonical-root milestone_closeout can read the accepted DONE milestone closeout snapshot for stories with completed milestone ledgers, while no-ledger stories still report missing rather than fabricated success.
acceptanceClaim: B-3a4d is accepted only if a canonical-root post-DONE regression proves milestone-closeout.json survives merge/cleanup and the no-ledger missing-snapshot behavior remains fail-closed.
